description: Machine-readable pin registry: every engine, instrument, and model behind the published tables, plus the per-capture overrides. Continuous-bench condition 1 (one-command reproduction). Update this file in the same commit as any capture that changes a pin.

litert-lm.vendored_via: ios/BenchmarkApp/scripts/bootstrap.sh (LITERTLM_TAG; local SwiftPM package, engine = release binaryTarget)

mlx-swift-lm.pinned_by: revision in ios/BenchmarkApp/project.yml (floating-branch incident documented there)

coreai-models.caveat: PLE models (Gemma-4 E2B/E4B) additionally require the unpublished local patch coreai-pipelined-static-inputs.patch (COREAI_STATIC_INPUTS) — this arm is NOT independently reproducible yet; see gap audit.

cactus.built: from source into cactus-ios.xcframework by bootstrap.sh

litert-pip-0.15.purpose: 0.15 side of the same-instrument version delta + resident A/B (litert-lm CLI; bench_litert_015_mac_speed.sh, 2026-08-04 rows)

litert-pip-0.14-contrast.purpose: 0.14 side of the same-instrument delta and resident A/B
litert-pip-0.14-contrast.note: despite the name, doubles as the conversion env: litert-torch 0.9.1 (release — the version int4 conversion requires) + ai-edge-litert 2.1.6; the 83-package freeze in the spec is the observed truth

litert-api-015-crossvalidation.purpose: gsm8k_litert_pip_thinking.py — released 0.15.0 dylib reproduces the ctx4096 yardstick pair (89/92) per-question

litert-community/gemma-4-E2B-it-litert-l.note: the June snapshot used unchanged across v0.13.1 and v0.15.0 rows; its template carries the enable_thinking branch

litert-mac-verify.purpose: Mac GSM8K quality instrument — the yardstick surface behind the LiteRT rows (v0.13.1 86.0; v0.15.0 88.0 at ctx2048, 89.0/92.0 off/thinking at ctx4096)

swift-litert-lm.note: official v0.15.0 release binaryTargets (zips + checksums as under arms.litert-lm captures) + official Swift wrapper re-vendored at the tag (ThinkingConfig) + LiteRTChat thinking passthrough. The v0.13.1-era 86.0 row's instrument state = fork main@c8eae63 (pre-ThinkingConfig; see tools/litert-mac-verify/README.md).

engine_version_stamping.mechanism: ios/BenchmarkApp/scripts/stamp_engine_pins.sh (xcodegen postBuildScripts on both targets + bootstrap step 8) records the OBSERVED vendored state — git describe of each Vendored/ clone, the CLiteRTLM binaryTarget zip+checksum from LiteRT-LM's Package.swift, the llama.xcframework.tag sidecar — into the BenchEnginePins Info.plist key and Vendored/engine-pins.json; BenchmarkResult carries the arm-under-test's pin as engineVersion/engineArtifact (schema v1). Observed state, not env defaults: requested tags and vendored reality drift (v0.13.1 clone ships v0.13.0 engine zips). Mac yardstick CLI: BENCH_ENGINE_PINS_FILE=ios/BenchmarkApp/Vendored/engine-pins.json. Unreadable pin => omitted => row records nil, never a guess.
engine_version_stamping.note: this lockfile remains the per-capture pin REGISTRY (what should be vendored); the stamp is the per-row WITNESS (what actually was) — regression tracking (condition 3) joins rows on the witness

external_instruments_not_yet_in_repo.coreai-llm-runner: parity_gsm8k.py --which coreai shells to COREAI_RUNNER (default ~/code/coreai/coreai-models/.build/release/llm-runner); gemma-4 PLE bundles additionally need the unpublished COREAI_STATIC_INPUTS engine patch — best-effort until Apple publishes it
external_instruments_not_yet_in_repo.coreai-thinking-tokenizer: --which coreai --thinking renders prompts with the HF tokenizer at ~/code/litertlm-convert/src_models/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-mobile-transformers
external_instruments_not_yet_in_repo.cactus-checkout: --which cactus needs a cactus checkout with a built engine dylib (methodology/cactus-arm-session.md)
